elements.name: night street with deep blue sky
two young men walking side by side seen from behind
shorter young man with backpack on the left
young man in blue denim jacket with empty hands on the right
tall concrete buildings with many lit windows
crowds of people as soft dark shapes on both sides

wrong_setting: Narrow street of low brick North American/European-style row houses with storefronts and Western sedans; no Addis Ababa concrete buildings or blue-and-white minibus taxis.
anatomy: The two characters are merged into a single figure: denim jacket and jeans from the second character combined with the first character's backpack and curly hair. Shapes in the hands are muddy.
notes: Regenerate with two separate figures side by side: the shorter one on the left in a dark jacket with the green backpack and plastic sandals, the taller one on the right in denim with empty hands. Set them on a wide Addis road with blue-and-white minibus taxis, tall concrete buildings, crowds and blank signs, in flat gouache rather than a glossy digital render.
